hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Group the logged actions by user and action date to eliminate duplicate events within the same day.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Use window ranking over activity dates partitioned by user to form consecutive island groups.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Filter for users who achieved the persistence threshold and present their identifiers in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RankedActions AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        action_date,
        DATEDIFF(action_date, '2000-01-01') - 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY action_date) AS grp
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT user_id, action_date
        FROM UserActions
    ) distinct_actions
),
GroupCounts AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_days
    FROM RankedActions
    GROUP BY user_id, grp
)
SELECT DISTINCT user_id
FROM GroupCounts
WHERE streak_days >= 3
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting and window partitioning by user and date completes in O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.

WITH RankedActions AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        action_date,
        (action_date - DATE '2000-01-01') - 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY action_date) AS grp
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT user_id, action_date
        FROM UserActions
    ) distinct_actions
),
GroupCounts AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_days
    FROM RankedActions
    GROUP BY user_id, grp
)

FROM GroupCounts
WHERE streak_days >= 3
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
